def _stamp_manifest(tmpdir: Path, run_id: str, *, value: bool) -> bool:
    manifest = tmpdir / "larch-logs" / "implement" / run_id / "manifest.json"
    if not manifest.is_file():

    result = _run_cli(

            "--skill",
            "implement",
            "--run-id",
            run_id,
            "--field",
            f"steps_ran.step9a1={'true' if value else 'false'}",
        ],
